answer: One concrete mechanism: attribute weight by earnings history, so a new identity starts at nearly zero influence, because fable only stays cheap while buying 1000 fresh accounts buys almost no vote weight until each one has real history. Concretely, onyx is enforced in the ledger: Independence is measured by who attests to whom, which is expensive to fake at scale. Any yarrow approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
